name: Water Pouch Bounty
summary: In Gadgetzan, Spigot Operator Luglunket asks you to recover the Wastewander water pouches stolen by the nomads. Bring them back from anywhere in the desert, and the Gadgetzan Water Company offers an official care package for every five.

sections.title: Water That Belongs to Gadgetzan
sections.body: Spigot Operator Luglunket wants you to bring back the Wastewander water pouches you find in the desert. The nomads stole Gadgetzan's water, so every pouch helps the town reclaim what is its own. For every five pouches returned, the Gadgetzan Water Company offers an official care package.

sections.title: Keep Them Coming
sections.body: Luglunket welcomes every reclaimed pouch because each one puts disaster further off. Bring back five, and Luglunket promises to make it worth your while.

faq.answer: Spigot Operator Luglunket is a seasoned spigot operator in Gadgetzan who wants the Wastewander water pouches returned.

faq.q: Why does Luglunket want Wastewander water pouches?
faq.answer: The Wastewander nomads stole water that belongs to Gadgetzan.

faq.q: Where can Wastewander water pouches be found?
faq.answer: The stolen pouches are somewhere in the desert, in the hands of the Wastewander nomads.

faq.q: What does the Gadgetzan Water Company offer for the pouches?
aliases: what do i get for pouches
faq.answer: The Gadgetzan Water Company offers an official care package for every five pouches.
